steps.what: Review the procedures before they are filed
Implement the accepted methods on the line

tasks.design: The engineer develops or implements operating methods or procedures. The engineer writes and reviews them. {DOCS} files only the accepted procedures. Implementing them on the line stays at full effort. A blank step in the procedure is not filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer wrote the procedure, filed it, and then showed the line.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted procedure can be filed as written.
tasks.still_hard: Writing the method and implementing it stay with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not file a procedure that still has a blank step.
tasks.altitude: The procedure is filed only after the engineer accepts that version. Implementation stays on the line.

reach.learn: Which steps the line cannot perform.

evidence.claim: An accepted operating procedure can be filed as written. Developing and implementing it stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a process that needs a method and ends when the accepted procedure is filed and the engineer has implemented it, or stops.
The draft has process identifier and ordered steps, written by the engineer. A blank step is left blank and is not filed.
The file uses the procedures accepted in the review. Implementation uses that same accepted text.
unknowns: Which procedures the line may not change locally.
research_questions: How often did the review stop a procedure because a step was blank?

already_counted.description: Developing operating methods or procedures is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: Correct a step in the procedure before the engineer accepts it.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: each procedure is still written by hand, so filing is a small part. High: the procedure is accepted and filed, and implementing it on the line remains. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Specify designs and estimate their cost

steps.what: Develop engineering specifications for automotive design concepts
Multiply stored quantities by stored prices
Review the estimates before they are filed

tasks.design: The engineer develops engineering specifications or cost estimates for automotive design concepts. The specification stays the engineer's, at full effort. {ERP} multiplies a stored quantity by a stored price. A blank price or quantity stays blank and stops the estimate. The engineer reviews the estimate, and only the accepted version is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer wrote the specification and multiplied the costs by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored quantity and a stored price can be multiplied. Filing is a write of the accepted estimate.
tasks.still_hard: Writing the specification and judging the estimate stay with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not file an estimate that skipped a blank price.
tasks.altitude: The estimate is filed only after the engineer accepts that version. The specification stays theirs.

reach.learn: Which prices are out of date.

evidence.claim: A stored quantity and a stored price can be multiplied into a draft estimate. The engineer writes the specification and reviews the estimate.

assumptions: The work starts with a design concept and ends when the specification is written and the accepted estimate is filed, or the engineer stops.

A price row has part identifier and price, entered by the engineer from a supplier's stated price. A quantity is entered by the engineer. A blank price or quantity is left blank and is not treated as zero.
The file uses the estimates accepted in the review. The multiplication does not write the specification.
unknowns: Which prices the engineer may use without a fresh supplier check.
research_questions: How often did a blank price stop the estimate?

already_counted.description: Developing the engineering specifications is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: Correct a price or a quantity before the estimate is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: prices are often blank, so the engineer still builds the estimate. High: prices are present, the engineer reviews the estimate, and only then is it filed. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Record the points those design reviews raised

tasks.design: The engineer conducts automotive design reviews. The review stays at full effort. Notes, if the engineer writes them, are not generated in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer sits the review and writes the points.
tasks.still_hard: Judging the design stays with the engineer in the review.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not close a review when a safety point is still open.
tasks.altitude: The design review stays the meeting. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Answer for their part of the design
reach.learn: Which points that colleague still disputes.

evidence.claim: Conducting an automotive design review stays manual.
The engineer who accepts a design in review remains responsible for the safety points they close.

assumptions: The work starts when the review meets and ends when the engineer has conducted it, or stops.
No system writes the review outcome. Upkeep is zero.
A later change to the design is a different task.
unknowns: Which design reviews require a signed record.
research_questions: Which safety points stayed open after the last review?

already_counted.description: Conducting automotive design reviews is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the review adds no separate record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every review is still conducted by the engineer. High: the same review remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Design vehicles that use lighter materials
Use aluminum, magnesium alloy, or plastic

tasks.design: The engineer designs vehicles that use lighter materials, such as aluminum, magnesium alloy, or plastic, to improve efficiency. Nothing is generated in {DOCS}. The design stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer chooses the material and judges the efficiency.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the material and the design stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer rejects a lighter material that misses a strength the design needs.
tasks.altitude: The material design stays the engineer's. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Confirm a material can be formed

evidence.claim: Designing vehicles around these lighter materials stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a mass or efficiency target and ends when the engineer has designed for it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A released material specification is a different task.
unknowns: Which strength limits a lighter material must still meet.
research_questions: Which materials did the engineer reject on strength?

already_counted.description: Designing vehicles that use lighter materials is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the design adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every material choice is still made by the engineer. High: the same design work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineer still tests, calibrates, and signs the design. A report, estimate, procedure, or document is written or published only after the engineer accepts that version.
reach: A project lead receives only a status report the engineer has accepted.
A production colleague receives only a procedure the engineer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required figure, milestone, or price is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a publication.
Keep testing, calibration, and design decisions in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every status report traces to a stored milestone, and the engineer still signs the exception.
